title: Second Pangasinan town imposes ASF-related pork ban

blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – Aguilar town in western Pangasinan has imposed a temporary ban on the entry into and exit from the town of live swine, pork, and pork by-products to control the spread of African Swine Fever (ASF). The ban is contained in Executive Order 76-2026 issued on Monday. Aguilar is the second town in Pangasinan that restricted the entry and exit of live swine and products within its territory.
